image_description: A composite image showing two distinct marine scenes. The left panel displays two dark green chitons (polyplacophores) clinging to a rocky substrate, exhibiting their characteristic eight-plated dorsal armor and oval shape. The right panel shows a cluster of white barnacles (cirripedes) attached to a rock surface, characterized by their calcareous shell plates arranged in a cone-like structure.
